name: njsla-practice-test
description: NJSLA practice tests for grades 3-8 ELA and Math (React, Express, generated question banks).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run generate:data
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
